description: This Java class 'MediaCodecWrapper' simplifies the Android MediaCodec API by managing buffer processing, decoding media streams, and providing callback mechanisms for format changes and decoded sample output.

classes.name: MediaCodecWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that manages MediaCodec buffer operations, decoding, and callbacks for media processing.

classes.name: OutputFormatChangedListener
classes.description: Interface for callback when media output format changes.

classes.name: OutputSampleListener
classes.description: Interface for callback when a decoded media sample is available.

classes.name: WriteException
classes.description: Custom exception class for write buffer errors.

methods.name: stopAndRelease
methods.description: Stops and releases the MediaCodec resources.

methods.name: getOutputFormatChangedListener
methods.description: Returns the registered output format change listener.

methods.name: setOutputFormatChangedListener
methods.description: Sets the listener and handler for output format change callbacks.

methods.name: fromVideoFormat
methods.description: Creates a MediaCodecWrapper instance configured for a specific video format and surface.

methods.name: writeSample
methods.description: Feeds a ByteBuffer sample into the decoder with presentation time and flags.

methods.name: writeSample
methods.description: Feeds media data from MediaExtractor into the decoder, handling secure and non-secure samples.

methods.name: peekSample
methods.description: Peeks at the next available decoded sample's buffer info without removing it from the queue.

methods.name: popSample
methods.description: Releases and optionally renders the decoded sample at the head of the output buffer queue.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Synchronizes internal buffer queues with the MediaCodec's current state.
